SELECT COALESCE(s.display_name, s.name) AS status_name, s.color AS status_color, s.category AS status_category, s.sort_order, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM issue i JOIN issue_status s ON s.id = i.status_id WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL
GROUP BY s.id, s.name, s.color, s.category, s.sort_order ORDER BY s.sort_order

SELECT COALESCE(i.priority, 'Normal') AS priority_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM issue i WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL
GROUP BY COALESCE(i.priority, 'Normal')

SELECT COALESCE(i.issue_type, 'Task') AS type_name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM issue i WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL
GROUP BY COALESCE(i.issue_type, 'Task') ORDER BY cnt DESC

SELECT CAST(i.created_at AS DATE) AS day, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM issue i WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL AND i.created_at >= #{startDate} AND i.created_at <= #{endDate}
GROUP BY CAST(i.created_at AS DATE) ORDER BY day

SELECT CAST(i.resolved_at AS DATE) AS day, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM issue i WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL AND i.resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND i.resolved_at >= #{startDate} AND i.resolved_at <= #{endDate}
GROUP BY CAST(i.resolved_at AS DATE) ORDER BY day

WITH -- 日期序列 date_series AS ( SELECT d::date AS day FROM generate_series( #{startDate}::timestamp, #{endDate}::timestamp, '1 day'::interval ) d ), -- 相关工单（在 endDate 之前创建的，未软删除） relevant_issues AS ( SELECT i.id, i.status_id, i.created_at FROM issue i WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL AND i.created_at < (#{endDate}::timestamp + interval '1 day')
), -- 每个工单的初始状态：取第一条 status 活动的 old_value，无活动则取当前状态名 first_status_change AS ( SELECT DISTINCT ON (a.issue_id) a.issue_id, a.old_value FROM issue_activity a WHERE a.field_name = 'status' AND a.issue_id IN (SELECT id FROM relevant_issues) ORDER BY a.issue_id, a.created_at ), issue_initial AS ( SELECT ri.id AS issue_id, ri.created_at::date AS created_date, COALESCE(fsc.old_value, s.name) AS initial_status FROM relevant_issues ri LEFT JOIN first_status_change fsc ON fsc.issue_id = ri.id LEFT JOIN issue_status s ON s.id = ri.status_id ), -- 所有 status 变更事件（包括 startDate 之前的——用于正确计算初始快照） status_transitions AS ( SELECT a.issue_id, a.created_at::date AS change_date, a.old_value AS left_status, a.new_value AS entered_status FROM issue_activity a WHERE a.field_name = 'status' AND a.issue_id IN (SELECT id FROM relevant_issues) AND a.created_at < (#{endDate}::timestamp + interval '1 day') ), -- 每天每状态的 delta 事件： -- 创建事件：工单创建当天，initial_status +1 -- 进入事件：变更当天，entered_status +1 -- 离开事件：变更当天，left_status -1 -- GREATEST 将 startDate 之前的事件截断到 startDate（确保累积从第一天开始） daily_delta AS ( SELECT clamped_day AS event_day, status_name, SUM(delta) AS delta FROM ( -- 创建事件 SELECT GREATEST(created_date, #{startDate}::date) AS clamped_day, initial_status AS status_name, 1 AS delta FROM issue_initial WHERE initial_status IS NOT NULL UNION ALL -- 进入事件 SELECT GREATEST(change_date, #{startDate}::date) AS clamped_day, entered_status AS status_name, 1 AS delta FROM status_transitions WHERE entered_status IS NOT NULL UNION ALL -- 离开事件 SELECT GREATEST(change_date, #{startDate}::date) AS clamped_day, left_status AS status_name, -1 AS delta FROM status_transitions WHERE left_status IS NOT NULL ) events GROUP BY clamped_day, status_name ), -- 对每个状态，按天做累积求和，得到"截至当天该状态的工单总数" cumulative_sparse AS ( SELECT event_day, status_name, SUM(delta) OVER (PARTITION BY status_name ORDER BY event_day) AS cnt FROM daily_delta ), -- 收集所有出现过的状态 all_statuses AS ( SELECT DISTINCT status_name FROM daily_delta ), -- 为每个状态×每天生成完整网格，LEFT JOIN 稀疏累积值 grid_with_sparse AS ( SELECT ds.day, ast.status_name, cs.cnt AS sparse_cnt FROM date_series ds CROSS JOIN all_statuses ast LEFT JOIN cumulative_sparse cs ON cs.status_name = ast.status_name AND cs.event_day = ds.day ), -- Forward fill：PostgreSQL 用 COUNT(non-null) OVER + FIRST_VALUE 技巧 -- 创建分组号：每次 sparse_cnt 不为 NULL 就开始新组 filled AS ( SELECT day, status_name, sparse_cnt, COUNT(sparse_cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY status_name ORDER BY day) AS grp FROM grid_with_sparse ), -- 用分组号取每组的第一个非 NULL 值（即前值填充） forward_filled AS ( SELECT day, status_name, FIRST_VALUE(sparse_cnt) OVER ( PARTITION BY status_name, grp ORDER BY day ) AS cnt FROM filled ) -- 最终输出：过滤掉 NULL 和 0 的行，LEFT JOIN 状态表获取颜色和排序 -- 使用 LEFT JOIN 确保已删除/重命名的历史状态仍参与计算（REQ-385） SELECT ff.day::text AS day, ff.status_name, COALESCE(s.color, '#6b7280') AS status_color, COALESCE(s.sort_order, 999) AS sort_order, COALESCE(ff.cnt, 0) AS cnt FROM forward_filled ff LEFT JOIN issue_status s ON s.name = ff.status_name WHERE COALESCE(ff.cnt, 0) > 0 ORDER BY ff.day, COALESCE(s.sort_order, 999)

SELECT date_trunc('week', i.resolved_at)::date::text AS period,
SELECT CAST(i.resolved_at AS DATE)::text AS period,
ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (i.resolved_at - i.created_at)) / 3600.0)::numeric, 2) AS avg_hours, ROUND(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (i.resolved_at - i.created_at)) / 3600.0)::numeric, 2) AS median_hours, ROUND(percentile_cont(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (i.resolved_at - i.created_at)) / 3600.0)::numeric, 2) AS p90_hours, COUNT(*) AS resolved_count FROM issue i WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL AND i.resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND i.resolved_at >= #{startDate} AND i.resolved_at <= #{endDate}
GROUP BY date_trunc('week', i.resolved_at) ORDER BY date_trunc('week', i.resolved_at)
GROUP BY CAST(i.resolved_at AS DATE) ORDER BY CAST(i.resolved_at AS DATE)

SELECT
COALESCE(i.issue_type, 'Task') AS group_name,
COALESCE(i.priority, 'Normal') AS group_name,
COALESCE(u.display_name, '未分配') AS group_name,
'全部' AS group_name,
ROUND(AVG(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (i.resolved_at - i.created_at)) / 3600.0)::numeric, 2) AS avg_hours, ROUND(percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (i.resolved_at - i.created_at)) / 3600.0)::numeric, 2) AS median_hours, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM issue i
LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = i.assignee_id
WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL AND i.resolved_at IS NOT NULL AND i.resolved_at >= #{startDate} AND i.resolved_at <= #{endDate}
GROUP BY
COALESCE(i.issue_type, 'Task')
COALESCE(i.priority, 'Normal')
COALESCE(u.display_name, '未分配')
1
ORDER BY cnt DESC

SELECT t.id AS entry_id, t.work_date::text AS work_date, u.display_name AS user_name, i.issue_key, i.title AS issue_title, p.name AS project_name, COALESCE(wiav.name, '未分类') AS work_type, COALESCE(t.duration, 0) AS minutes, t.description FROM time_entry t JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = t.user_id JOIN issue i ON i.id = t.issue_id JOIN project p ON p.id = t.project_id LEFT JOIN time_entry_attribute_value teav ON teav.time_entry_id = t.id AND teav.attribute_id = #{workTypeAttributeId} LEFT JOIN work_item_attribute_value wiav ON wiav.id = teav.value_id WHERE t.issue_id = #{issueId} AND i.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY t.work_date DESC, t.id DESC

SELECT t.id AS entry_id, t.work_date::text AS work_date, u.display_name AS user_name, i.issue_key, i.title AS issue_title, p.name AS project_name, COALESCE(wiav.name, '未分类') AS work_type, COALESCE(t.duration, 0) AS minutes, t.description FROM time_entry t JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = t.user_id JOIN issue i ON i.id = t.issue_id JOIN project p ON p.id = t.project_id LEFT JOIN time_entry_attribute_value teav ON teav.time_entry_id = t.id AND teav.attribute_id = #{workTypeAttributeId} LEFT JOIN work_item_attribute_value wiav ON wiav.id = teav.value_id WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.work_date >= #{startDate}::date AND t.work_date <= #{endDate}::date AND i.deleted_at IS NULL
AND t.project_id IN #{pid}
AND 1=0
ORDER BY t.work_date DESC, t.id DESC

SELECT t.user_id, u.display_name AS user_name, COALESCE(SUM(t.duration), 0) AS total_minutes FROM time_entry t JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = t.user_id WHERE t.work_date >= #{startDate}::date AND t.work_date <= #{endDate}::date AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM issue i WHERE i.id = t.issue_id AND i.deleted_at IS NOT NULL)
AND t.project_id IN #{pid}
AND 1=0
GROUP BY t.user_id, u.display_name ORDER BY total_minutes DESC

SELECT t.project_id AS project_id, p.name AS project_name, COALESCE(SUM(t.duration), 0) AS total_minutes FROM time_entry t JOIN project p ON p.id = t.project_id WHERE t.work_date >= #{startDate}::date AND t.work_date <= #{endDate}::date AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM issue i WHERE i.id = t.issue_id AND i.deleted_at IS NOT NULL)
AND t.project_id IN #{pid}
AND 1=0
GROUP BY t.project_id, p.name ORDER BY total_minutes DESC

SELECT COALESCE(wiav.name, '未分类') AS work_type, COALESCE(SUM(t.duration), 0) AS total_minutes FROM time_entry t LEFT JOIN time_entry_attribute_value teav ON teav.time_entry_id = t.id AND teav.attribute_id = #{workTypeAttributeId} LEFT JOIN work_item_attribute_value wiav ON wiav.id = teav.value_id WHERE t.work_date >= #{startDate}::date AND t.work_date <= #{endDate}::date AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM issue i WHERE i.id = t.issue_id AND i.deleted_at IS NOT NULL)
AND t.project_id IN #{pid}
AND 1=0
GROUP BY COALESCE(wiav.name, '未分类') ORDER BY total_minutes DESC

SELECT t.work_date::text AS work_date, COALESCE(SUM(t.duration), 0) AS total_minutes FROM time_entry t WHERE t.work_date >= #{startDate}::date AND t.work_date <= #{endDate}::date AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM issue i WHERE i.id = t.issue_id AND i.deleted_at IS NOT NULL)
AND t.project_id IN #{pid}
AND 1=0
GROUP BY t.work_date ORDER BY t.work_date ASC

SELECT p.name AS project_name, u.display_name AS user_name, COALESCE(SUM(t.duration), 0) AS total_minutes FROM time_entry t JOIN project p ON p.id = t.project_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = t.user_id WHERE t.work_date >= #{startDate}::date AND t.work_date <= #{endDate}::date AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM issue i WHERE i.id = t.issue_id AND i.deleted_at IS NOT NULL)
AND t.project_id IN #{pid}
AND 1=0
GROUP BY p.name, u.display_name ORDER BY p.name ASC, total_minutes DESC

SELECT p.name AS project_name, SUM(i.estimated_hours) AS estimated_hours_sum, COALESCE(SUM(i.spent_hours), 0) AS spent_hours_sum, COUNT(*) AS issue_count FROM issue i JOIN project p ON p.id = i.project_id WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL AND i.estimated_hours IS NOT NULL AND i.estimated_hours > 0
AND i.project_id IN #{pid}
AND 1=0
GROUP BY p.name ORDER BY estimated_hours_sum DESC

SELECT
COALESCE(cfo_primary.value, '未设置')
COALESCE(cfu_primary.display_name, '未设置')
COALESCE(cfv_primary.value, '未设置')
s.name COALESCE(i.priority, 'Normal') COALESCE(i.issue_type, 'Task') COALESCE(u.display_name, '未分配') p.name s.name
AS label, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM issue i JOIN issue_status s ON s.id = i.status_id
LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = i.assignee_id
JOIN project p ON p.id = i.project_id
LEFT JOIN custom_field_value cfv_primary ON cfv_primary.issue_id = i.id AND cfv_primary.custom_field_id = #{params.customFieldId}
LEFT JOIN custom_field_option cfo_primary ON cfo_primary.id = CAST(cfv_primary.value AS BIGINT)
LEFT JOIN sys_user cfu_primary ON cfu_primary.id = CAST(cfv_primary.value AS BIGINT)
WHERE i.deleted_at IS NULL

COALESCE(cfo_primary.value, '未设置')
COALESCE(cfu_primary.display_name, '未设置')
COALESCE(cfv_primary.value, '未设置')
s.name COALESCE(i.priority, 'Normal') COALESCE(i.issue_type, 'Task') COALESCE(u.display_name, '未分配') p.name s.name
ORDER BY cnt ASC ORDER BY label ASC ORDER BY label DESC ORDER BY cnt DESC
